fusions.name: Cropped Short
fusions.desc: Crops a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to everything in it. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lowered Head
fusions.desc: A head-down ram that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Slow Digestion
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds. The healing rises 7% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 35%.

fusions.name: Unhurried Hunger
fusions.desc: After 12 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 12 seconds.
